dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Amir, can I ask you something? I've been thinking about giving up the research assistant position.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You just took it on two weeks ago.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I know. But it's taking up too much time. I can't keep up with my coursework and the volleyball training at the same time.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Have you tried cutting back on something else to free up time?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I've cut down on social media. And I've put off two friends for the third time this week. I feel bad about that.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Did you talk it over with Professor Sultanova? Maybe she could work something out — a reduced schedule or something.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I haven't brought it up with her yet. I keep putting it off.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: You should bring it up soon. If you carry on like this without saying anything, you'll burn out.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I know. I need to sort it out. I just don't want to let her down.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: She'd rather you speak up now than drop out later. Trust me.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll set up a meeting with her tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Good. And don't put it off again.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I know, I know. Can you help me work out what to say?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Sure. Write down the main points first. Then we'll go over it together.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Thank you. I really didn't want to give this up. I was looking forward to the research.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: And you still can do it — just on terms that work for you. Don't give up on it. Find a way through.

questions.text: "It's taking up too much time." — "taking up" here means:
questions.hint: "take up" = to use or consume (time, space, energy). "It's TAKING UP too much time." ✅

questions.text: "I keep putting it off." — "putting off" means:
questions.hint: "put off" = to postpone or delay. "I keep PUTTING IT OFF." ✅

questions.text: "I've cut down on social media." — Can you say "cut social media down"?
questions.hint: "cut down on" is INSEPARABLE — you cannot split it. "Cut down on social media" ✅ NOT "cut social media down on".

questions.text: "I haven't brought ___ up with her yet." (the issue)
questions.hint: Separable phrasal verb: "bring up" can split: "bring IT up." Pronoun goes between verb and particle. ✅

questions.text: "We'll go over it together." — "go over" means:
questions.hint: "go over" = to review, examine, or discuss something carefully. ✅

"set up" = to arrange or organise. "Set UP a meeting." ✅ (separable: also "set it up")
